    - generic: 01 / FIELD NOTES
    - button "Close field notes" [active]: ✕
    - heading "STAY ALIVE. KEEP MOVING." [level=2]:
      - text: STAY ALIVE.

    - paragraph: Clear a path through the building. Recover weapons from fallen enemies, watch your ammunition, and use cover between shots.

    - paragraph: "Gamepad: sticks move/look · RT fire · LT aim · A jump · B crouch · X reload · Y pick up · RB / R3 melee · L3 sprint · D-pad up rage · D-pad down drop · Start pause. Arrow keys also turn the camera."
    - generic: TOUCH CONTROLS
    - paragraph: Enable on-screen touch controls in Settings. Drag the left stick to move and swipe the right side to look. Tap and release FIRE to attack once. Drag FIRE to aim without firing. RUN and CROUCH toggle on each tap. USE picks up weapons and ammunition. Look sensitivity also adjusts touch look.
    - paragraph: SIGHTS appears with firearms and toggles a closer view with tighter shot spread. It is separate from swiping to turn the camera. RAGE appears only when you can activate it. JUMP, RELOAD, MELEE, DROP, and PAUSE handle the other actions.
    - paragraph: Melee keeps your firearm and ammunition. Rage unlocks below 30% health after 4 kills in the last 60 seconds. Press T, D-pad up, or the touch RAGE button to double current health. Kill within 10 seconds to keep the remaining boost; otherwise health returns to its starting value. Pausing freezes both clocks.
    - generic: REMEMBER
    - paragraph: The street gives you a choice. The consequences are yours.
    - button "BACK TO MISSION":
      - text: BACK TO MISSION
      - generic: ↗
